## PXL Components Library Overview

**Tech Stack:**

- Kendo UI components (21.2.0) for advanced widgets
- Storybook 10.1.6 for documentation with Figma integration
- Testing: Playwright for E2E tests, linting with ESLint 9.39.1

**Component Location:**
Components defined in `/projects/pxl-components/src/lib/components/` with 47 components total.

**Available UI Components (47 total):**
Alert, Animation, Breadcrumbs, Cards, Chart, Chip-Filter, Chips, Code-Highlight, Copy-to-Clipboard, Date-Range-Filter, Drawer, Empty-State, Expand-Region, Form-Field, Highlight, Icon, Image, Information-Label, Inline-Date-Range, Layout, Logo, Logo-Loader, Page-Header, Popover, Progress, Search-Input, Section-Header, Selectable-Card, Skeleton-Loader, Skip-Link, Stacked-Text-Display, Status-Bar, Status-Indicator, Step-Summary, Stepper-Icons, Stepper-Actions, Tooltip, Typography, Vertical-Nav, Vertical-Nav-Dropdown, Vertical-Nav-Link, NGX-Scrollspy, Control-Value-Accessor (utility)

**Design Tokens & Theming:**
- CSS variables with light/dark mode support via `prefers-color-scheme` media queries
- Theme palette system: primary, accent, warn, secondary, tertiary, action, success, error, warning, info, brand variants, and 12 tag colors
- Sensitivity levels (high/medium/non/indeterminate/not-applicable) for specialized use cases
- Located in `/projects/pxl-components/src/lib/styles/` with organized subdirectories: variables, palettes, mixins, utilities, keyframes, overrides, icons
